## Case format
```json
{ "case_id": "PUB-01", "courier": "Pathao Courier", "rider": "Rasel", "handover_time": "2026-08-26T10:15",
  "parcels": [ {"order_id": "ORD-6919", "cod_bdt": "2875.00", "area": "Chawkbazar", "lat": 22.35936, "lng": 91.8377},
               {"order_id": "ORD-6920", "cod_bdt": "899.50",  "area": "Agrabad",    "lat": 22.32695, "lng": 91.81576} ],
  "cash_returned_bdt": "7209.75" }
```
Parcels are in the order they were typed. Money is a 2 dp string in taka. Coordinates are synthetic
Chattogram points (area centre plus jitter); public batches hold 20 to 40 parcels.
